title: Evolve a closed account-state model
statement: Update the existing source to the exact required declarations. Add suspended(reason) to the closed account-state model. can_sign_in is true only for active. status_label returns active, suspended:<reason>, locked:<failed_attempts>, or closed. Add suspend(state, reason): active becomes suspended with the new reason; an already suspended state keeps its existing reason; locked and closed preserve their state and payload.
constraints: return one complete replacement file and preserve all existing behavior
represent every state and payload with the exact declared closed types
handle every state variant explicitly without catch-all or default branches
do not throw, panic, perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

    locked(failed_attempts: int64)
    closed

function suspend(state: AccountState, reason: string) returns AccountState
